con:testCase.name: WorldCup E2E Functional Test
con:testCase.con:description:
End-to-end functional test suite for the WorldCup API. Tests the full lifecycle of match submission and verification using data-generated country matchups and scores across a simulated group stage.
Flow per iteration: 1. POST /scores Submit a match result (data-driven: 6 matches) 2. Property Transfer Extract the returned matchId 3. GET /scores/{matchId} Verify the exact match was stored correctly 4. GET /scores Verify the match appears in the full list 5. GET /table Verify both teams appear and table is sorted by points
After all data rows are processed: 6. Negative: POST with missing fields expects 400 7. Negative: POST with negative scores expects 400 8. Negative: GET with a non-existent UUID expects 404 9. Negative: GET with a malformed UUID expects 400 or 404 10. Final GET /table with full schema and sort-order validation
